cases.description: Daily operations belong to the sibling skill

failed_assertions.value:
The response hands day-to-day operation (exec/run/refresh/troubleshoot)
to the use-workshop skill rather than duplicating an operations
tutorial inside onboarding. Brief pointers (e.g. workshop shell) are
fine.
failed_assertions.reason: The output explicitly states at the end that "these are existing-workshop operations, covered by the use-workshop workflow rather than onboarding," acknowledging the boundary. However, the body of the response contradicts this by providing a comprehensive operations tutorial—full bash examples for shell/run/exec/refresh, post-refresh verification steps (workshop changes, tasks, info), detailed troubleshooting guidance for failed refreshes (--continue/--abort), and an exception note about setup-b
